title: kith-chat: outbound read receipt sending via OutboxStore
description:
When an owner marks a received message as read (Message/set update with readAt), kithd should enqueue a Peer/receipt to the original sender. This was supposed to be done in KITH-df2 but was left as dead code (empty if block) because OutboxStore has no receipt enqueue method.

Implement:
1. Add OutboxStore::enqueue_receipt(message_id, peer_user_id, peer_mailbox_host, kind, read_at_unix, now_unix) — stores a receipt delivery task
2. Add receipt handling to outbox_tick: detect receipt entries, build Peer/receipt JMAP request, deliver to peer
3. In kith-chat message.rs process_update: after update_read_at, look up message + contact and call outbox.enqueue_receipt if contact is known and unblocked
4. Add OutboxEntry::kind field to distinguish message delivery vs receipt delivery

Why: Without this, read receipts are never sent; peers never see 'read' state on their outgoing messages.
